Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery

time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.OEM/Bidder must have ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certificate and copy to be submitted along wi th Bid. 2. Bidder should have experience in supplying BIS licensed security product strong room doors, safe and g old safe of more than 10 years. the bidder should provide BIS certificate for 10 years also there should not be any history of failure of quality test in the same period. 3.OEMs or authorized suppliers having valid BIS license for the specified product of more than 5 years will only be allowed to participate or will only be technically eligible in tendering on GeM. Copy of BIS License s hould be provided. 4.The OEM have not been suspended/delisted/blacklisted by any other Govt. Ministry/ Department/ Public Sector Undertaking/IRDA/SEBI/Autonomous Body/Financial Institu tion/Court etc in last Five financial years for supply or services of goods. Undertaking from authorized signatory on Stamp Paper Rs. 100/- by Authorised Signatory or Powe r of Attorney should be submitted. 5.OEM must have BIS Labelled Physical locks in strong room doors and it should be in -house manufacturing. Copy of BIS license for IS 17566:2021 should be provided. 6.The Bidder should have a network of “Authorized Dealers” and “Service Centers” a t Bathinda/Ludhiana for the security related products. Self-certification mentioning lis t of the Support Centre is to be submitted. Documentary proof (Office registration de tails/GST Certificates/Contact Person/Contact Number with mail id ) to be submitted along with the bid. 7.The bidder should be either the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or their aut horized representative in India. In cases where the manufacturer has submitted the b id, the bids of its authorized dealer will not be considered and EMD will be returned. And in case of violations, both infringing bids will be rejected. 8. Past experience of working with PSBs/Financial Institutions during past 5 years (Co mpleted Jobs) as on bid date with (a) 80% of quantity proposed in single tender work order or (b) 50% or more of the same in each two work orders or (c) 40% or more of the same in each three work orders. Purchase order copies issued by the Bank/ Banks, Financial Institutions, Government organizations. Satisfa ctory delivery certificate from the respective offices indicating the dates and quantities supplied in respec t of the above mentioned purchase order. 9. copy of Bank Solvency certificate of Rs. six lakhs not older than 6 months at the cl osing time of bid should be attached. PNB has reserve the right to cancel the BID at any stage. .
